🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.70% | 1M: -2.33%) while XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +5.64%); VXX rising (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND and SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +0.33%) confirm mixed risk signals with strong breadth.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear increasing: VXX (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising). Credit stress showing strain as HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: +0.97% | 1M: -1.25%) RECOVERY imply HYG/LQD weakening (↓ falling); commodity/industrial signals (CPER (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND) also tilt toward caution.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP CORRECTION (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +1.90%) with TLT RECOVERY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -1.72%) — yield-driven bid into duration even as SPY/TLT slips (↓ falling).

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and defensives leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +6.46%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +5.64%), XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +5.08%); Tech lagging with XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.70% | 1M: -2.33%). Style: Value over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US in short-term pullback: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +0.33%); EM underperformance EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -6.07%) and China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.17% | 1M: -1.02%) keep global beta constrained while IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +6.58%) shows crypto divergence.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation cooling: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -6.06%), IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -5.25%) and IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +6.58%) point to lower risk tolerance.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Oil-led strength: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +10.31%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.15% | 1M: +4.15%) versus softer industrials CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -0.40%) and gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -4.10%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing conviction: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +6.46%); natural gas mixed with UNG CORRECTION (1W: -3.18% | 1M: +3.19%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad sector strength (10/11) with multiple ETFs ABOVE TREND (XLE, XLP, XLV). DIVERGENCE: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +0.33%) vs TLT RECOVERY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -1.72%) and several 1W/1M mismatches (IBIT, UNG, UUP) → minor-to-moderate divergence to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor energy and staples ETFs showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +6.46%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +5.64%)); reduce exposure to XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.70% | 1M: -2.33%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -6.06%); bonds favored as a duration ballast (TLT RECOVERY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -1.72%)).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +6.46%) ABOVE TREND, XLP (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +5.64%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -7.70% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND, EEM (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +10.31%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +9.15% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND, GLD (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -4.10%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND around 20 for rising fear; monitor credit signal HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.97% | 1M: -1.25%) RECOVERY with HYG/LQD level ~0.74; track XLK (1W: -7.70% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND as the growth pivot.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, but VXX rising (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND and SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +0.33%) confirm mixed risk with deteriorating short-term risk signals. Energy and staples showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +6.46%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +5.64%)). Key risk: divergence between equities (SPY CORRECTION) and bonds (TLT RECOVERY) plus multiple 1W/1M mismatches to monitor.
